## Setup

This report follows `preregs/income_prereg` using the pilot file `POLITSOLID_Pretest_interim_11032026.sav`. The pilot supports the main individual-level resource analyses, interaction checks, secondary solidarity outcomes, and item-level ordered-model robustness. The preregistered weighted specification cannot be run yet because the pilot `.sav` does not contain design weights.

```{r}
source("analysis_helpers.R")
load_analysis_packages()

input_file <- fs::path("data", "POLITSOLID_Pretest_interim_11032026.sav")
analysis_data <- build_analysis_data(input_file)

controls <- c(
  "age",
  "gender_binary",
  "factor(education_level)",
  "factor(employment_status)",
  "factor(country)"
)

main_outcome <- "solidarity_territorial"
secondary_outcomes <- c(
  "solidarity_group",
  "welfare_chauvinism",
  "solidarity_deserving",
  "solidarity_migrant"
)

resource_terms <- c(
  "income_rank_country_z",
  "fresil_z",
  "ecohhld_z"
)

interaction_terms <- c(
  "income_rank_country_z:ideology_right_z",
  "fresil_z:ideology_right_z",
  "ecohhld_z:ideology_right_z",
  "income_rank_country_z:dependants",
  "fresil_z:dependants",
  "ecohhld_z:dependants"
)

main_predictors <- c(
  resource_terms,
  "ideology_right_z",
  "dependants",
  interaction_terms
)

predictor_labels <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term, ~term_label,
  "income_rank_country_z", "Income rank within country",
  "fresil_z", "Financial resilience",
  "ecohhld_z", "Subjective household finances",
  "ideology_right_z", "Right ideology",
  "dependants", "Dependants in household",
  "income_rank_country_z:ideology_right_z", "Income × ideology",
  "fresil_z:ideology_right_z", "Resilience × ideology",
  "ecohhld_z:ideology_right_z", "Subjective finances × ideology",
  "income_rank_country_z:dependants", "Income × dependants",
  "fresil_z:dependants", "Resilience × dependants",
  "ecohhld_z:dependants", "Subjective finances × dependants"
)
```

## Outcome and Construct Checks

The preregistration asks whether territorial and group solidarity form one construct or two related dimensions. The section below reports simple reliability checks and a PCA-style eigenvalue summary.

```{r}
construct_items <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    plsolmuni,
    plsolcntry,
    plsoleu,
    plsolchld,
    plsolold,
    plsolpoor,
    plsolimmeu,
    plsolimmnoneu
  )

alpha_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~scale, ~alpha,
  "Territorial solidarity", cohens_alpha(analysis_data, c("plsolmuni", "plsolcntry", "plsoleu")),
  "Group solidarity", cohens_alpha(analysis_data, c("plsolchld", "plsolold", "plsolpoor", "plsolimmeu", "plsolimmnoneu")),
  "All solidarity items", cohens_alpha(analysis_data, names(construct_items))
)

cor_mat <- stats::cor(construct_items, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
eigen_table <- tibble::tibble(
  component = seq_along(eigen(cor_mat)$values),
  eigenvalue = eigen(cor_mat)$values
)

alpha_table %>%
  render_table(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
ggplot(eigen_table, aes(x = component, y = eigenvalue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#6c584c") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "Eigenvalues for the eight solidarity items",
    x = "Principal component",
    y = "Eigenvalue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Visual Checks for the Main Resource Hypotheses

```{r}
visual_data <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    solidarity_territorial,
    `Income rank` = income_rank_country,
    `Financial resilience` = fresil,
    `Subjective finances` = ecohhld
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -solidarity_territorial,
    names_to = "resource",
    values_to = "predictor"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(solidarity_territorial), !is.na(predictor)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(resource) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin = dplyr::ntile(predictor, 5)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(resource, bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    predictor_mean = mean(predictor, na.rm = TRUE),
    solidarity_mean = mean(solidarity_territorial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(visual_data, aes(x = predictor_mean, y = solidarity_mean)) +
  geom_line(color = "#355070", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#e56b6f") +
  facet_wrap(~ resource, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 4), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Binned descriptive checks for the main resource predictors",
    x = "Predictor value",
    y = "Mean territorial solidarity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Main OLS Model

```{r}
analysis_main <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `income_rank_country_z:ideology_right_z` = income_rank_country_z * ideology_right_z,
    `fresil_z:ideology_right_z` = fresil_z * ideology_right_z,
    `ecohhld_z:ideology_right_z` = ecohhld_z * ideology_right_z,
    `income_rank_country_z:dependants` = income_rank_country_z * dependants,
    `fresil_z:dependants` = fresil_z * dependants,
    `ecohhld_z:dependants` = ecohhld_z * dependants
  )

main_sample <- model_sample(analysis_main, main_outcome, c(main_predictors, controls))
main_model <- fit_ols(main_sample, build_formula(main_outcome, main_predictors, controls))

main_results <- robust_tidy_lm(main_model) %>%
  coef_plot_data(label_map = predictor_labels, keep_terms = predictor_labels$term)

main_results %>%
  dplyr::select(term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimate)) %>%
  render_table(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
ggplot(main_results, aes(x = estimate, y = forcats::fct_rev(term_label), xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.15, color = "#6d597a") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "#b56576") +
  labs(
    title = "Income prereg: robust OLS coefficients",
    x = "Coefficient estimate",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Interaction Plots

```{r}
mode_country <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::count(country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(country)

mode_education <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::count(education_level, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(education_level)

mode_employment <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::count(employment_status, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(employment_status)

interaction_grid_ideology <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  income_rank_country_z = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 60),
  ideology_right_z = c(-1, 0, 1)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fresil_z = 0,
    ecohhld_z = 0,
    dependants = 0,
    `income_rank_country_z:ideology_right_z` = income_rank_country_z * ideology_right_z,
    `fresil_z:ideology_right_z` = 0,
    `ecohhld_z:ideology_right_z` = 0,
    `income_rank_country_z:dependants` = 0,
    `fresil_z:dependants` = 0,
    `ecohhld_z:dependants` = 0,
    age = mean(analysis_data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    gender_binary = 0,
    education_level = mode_education,
    employment_status = mode_employment,
    country = mode_country,
    ideology_group = dplyr::case_when(
      ideology_right_z == -1 ~ "Left-leaning",
      ideology_right_z == 0 ~ "Center",
      TRUE ~ "Right-leaning"
    ),
    predicted = stats::predict(main_model, newdata = ., type = "response")
  )

plot_ideology <- ggplot(interaction_grid_ideology, aes(x = income_rank_country_z, y = predicted, color = ideology_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Income rank by ideology",
    x = "Income rank within country (z)",
    y = "Predicted territorial solidarity",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

interaction_grid_dependants <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  fresil_z = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 60),
  dependants = c(0, 1)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    income_rank_country_z = 0,
    ecohhld_z = 0,
    ideology_right_z = 0,
    `income_rank_country_z:ideology_right_z` = 0,
    `fresil_z:ideology_right_z` = 0,
    `ecohhld_z:ideology_right_z` = 0,
    `income_rank_country_z:dependants` = 0,
    `fresil_z:dependants` = fresil_z * dependants,
    `ecohhld_z:dependants` = 0,
    age = mean(analysis_data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    gender_binary = 0,
    education_level = mode_education,
    employment_status = mode_employment,
    country = mode_country,
    dependant_group = dplyr::if_else(dependants == 1, "Dependants", "No dependants"),
    predicted = stats::predict(main_model, newdata = ., type = "response")
  )

plot_dependants <- ggplot(interaction_grid_dependants, aes(x = fresil_z, y = predicted, color = dependant_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Financial resilience by dependants",
    x = "Financial resilience (z)",
    y = "Predicted territorial solidarity",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

plot_ideology + plot_dependants
```

## Secondary Outcomes and FDR Correction

```{r}
outcome_family <- c(main_outcome, secondary_outcomes)

family_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  outcome_family,
  function(outcome_name) {
    sample_data <- model_sample(analysis_main, outcome_name, c(main_predictors, controls))
    model_fit <- fit_ols(sample_data, build_formula(outcome_name, main_predictors, controls))

    robust_tidy_lm(model_fit) %>%
      dplyr::filter(term %in% resource_terms) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(outcome = outcome_name)
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.value.fdr = stats::p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  coef_plot_data(label_map = predictor_labels)

family_results %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p.value.fdr) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(term_label, p.value.fdr) %>%
  render_table(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
ggplot(family_results, aes(x = estimate, y = forcats::fct_rev(outcome), xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = term_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Main resource terms across preregistered outcome family",
    x = "Coefficient estimate",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Ordered Logit Item-Level Robustness

```{r}
ordered_items <- c(
  "plsolmuni",
  "plsolcntry",
  "plsoleu",
  "plsolchld",
  "plsolold",
  "plsolpoor",
  "plsolimmeu",
  "plsolimmnoneu"
)

ordered_predictors <- c("income_rank_country_z", "fresil_z", "ecohhld_z", "ideology_right_z", "dependants")

ordered_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ordered_items,
  function(outcome_name) {
    ordered_data <- model_sample(analysis_data, outcome_name, c(ordered_predictors, controls))
    ordered_model <- fit_ordered(ordered_data, build_formula(outcome_name, ordered_predictors, controls))

    ordered_tidy(ordered_model) %>%
      coef_plot_data(label_map = predictor_labels, keep_terms = ordered_predictors) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        term_label,
        estimate,
        conf.low,
        conf.high,
        p.value
      )
  }
)

ordered_results %>%
  dplyr::arrange(outcome, dplyr::desc(estimate)) %>%
  render_table(digits = 3)
```

## Notes

- `welfare_chauvinism` is operationalized here as the deserving-target solidarity mean minus the migrant-target solidarity mean, which matches the logic of the preregistration given the current pilot items.
- `income_rank_country` is built as a within-country percentile rank from the country-specific household income variables to respect the preregistered cross-country comparability logic.
- The pilot file does not contain weights, so the weighted specification is not run here. The current report is therefore best treated as a prereg-consistent pilot analysis rather than a final confirmatory model set.
